image_manifest.description: An asset manifest for a stylized 3D rendered scene featuring two pterosaurs of vastly different scales balancing on a wooden seesaw on a tropical beach.

assets.name: Header Text
assets.description: Red text with a yellow 3D border reading 'Weigh The Pterosaur!' centered in the upper-middle of the frame.

assets.name: Large Pterosaur Character
assets.description: A gigantic, slender pterosaur with slate-blue skin and a pale silvery-grey underbelly, standing on the right side of the seesaw. It has a long neck and a small crest on its head.

assets.name: Small Pterosaur Character
assets.description: A small, tan-colored pterosaur with a prominent reddish crest, perched on the elevated left side of the seesaw.

assets.name: Wooden Seesaw Item
assets.description: A simple wooden seesaw made of a long plank balanced on a cylindrical log pivot, resting on the sand.

assets.name: Solnhofen Tropical Beach Environment
assets.description: A sunny tropical beach with fine white sand, scattered small rocks, and bird-like footprints. In the background, turquoise water meets a light blue sky with fluffy white clouds.

assets.name: Cliffside Background
assets.description: A sheer, orange-tinted limestone cliff on the left side of the background, topped with sparse tropical greenery and a palm tree.

assets.name: Bottom Right Watermark
assets.description: A small, translucent four-pointed star lens-flare logo located in the bottom-right corner.
